# 狸花猫教练头像

Mode: built-in ImageGen, generate. One original transparent sprite sheet; cells from left to right: idle, good, bad (thoughtful feedback). Asset: `coach-tabby.png` (2172 × 724). Integrated at 54 × 54 CSS pixels. No production course source changes.

The page serves `coach-tabby.webp` (972 × 324), a resized compressed copy with transparency preserved. The PNG is the original reusable source.

## Exact prompt

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE cohesive avatar expression sprite sheet for a Chinese card-game teaching coach.
Primary request: Generate one horizontal transparent PNG, 1536 x 512 pixels or exact 3:1 aspect ratio, with three equal square cells. These are three expressions of the SAME identical Chinese li hua tabby cat head, with exactly matching head proportions, fur markings, colors, size, and position within each cell.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no background color.
Subject: head only, front-facing Chinese li hua tabby cat. Gray-brown fur, dark charcoal-brown bold M forehead marking, broad tapered cheek stripes, pointed ears with dusty pink inner ears, cream muzzle and chin, small brick-colored nose.
Expressions, left to right: left attentive and friendly with almond-shaped yellow-green eyes; middle happy with eyes closed and a smile; right thoughtful and mildly puzzled with one brow raised, never angry or sad.
Style/medium: clean flat cartoon illustration with bold rounded contours and simple large color shapes, readable at a 54px avatar size.
Composition/framing: the three equal square cells are invisible, with NO dividers. Each head centered with generous safe transparent padding, same scale and aligned baseline; all ears and outlines completely inside its cell. Keep facial identity and stripe shapes identical across expressions.
Constraints: One sprite-sheet asset, not three candidate designs. Head only, no clothes, accessories, paws, or body. No text, labels, cell separators, frames, badges, gradients, texture, shine, 3D, watermark, or drop shadows. Output transparent PNG with true alpha.
```
